get.description:
Firebase web config for browser Google sign-in.

The API key identifies the Firebase project to the Web SDK and is not a
secret; it is already visible in any client that signs users in.

post.description: Create a session. Auth: none. Rate limit: 5/min/IP, 20/hour/device.
Record the consent decision and, on acceptance, actually start the call.
Support joins by code or session id. Auth: support user.
Fresh LiveKit token for the same identity.

get.description: Full session state. Also the agent worker's reconciliation source.

post.description: Delete the LiveKit room, which cascades to egress and the agent job.

delete.description: Purge media, transcript rows and exports. Requires an admin claim.

post.description: Enable/disable the AI agent's speech. **Support auth only** (FR-4.1).

Record a mode transition. Called by the agent worker (service auth) or
forced by support.

Batched, idempotent utterance ingest. Auth: service (agent worker).

INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (session_id, client_utterance_id) DO NOTHING.
That index is what makes the agent's retry-with-backoff loop safe.

Only finalized utterances arrive here; interims are never persisted (FR-6.3).

get.description:
Ordered utterances with a cursor. The support panel reconciles against
this every 10s; the low-latency path is the lk.transcription text stream.

post.description:
Force the JSONL/VTT/TXT/session.json export. Normally triggered by the
room_finished webhook; this endpoint exists for retry. Idempotent.

get.description:
List the session's media with V4 signed URLs.

The backend never proxies media bytes -- egress writes straight to GCS and
clients fetch via short-lived signed URLs (SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS).
Legacy/short entry: same as ``/`` (``/call?call=x`` etc. included).
Path-style link ``/call/<code>``: redirects to the canonical ``/?call=<code>``.
Pre-join info: recording notice, and whether the meeting is running.

post.description: Mint a guest LiveKit token for an open call. Auth: none (link-only).

get.description:
Recordings for a call, with short-lived signed URLs to play them.

Auth: none -- anyone holding the call link may view its recordings, by
product decision. Call ids from GET /call are unguessable; hand-picked ids
like "team-standup" are not.

post.description:
End the meeting: stop recordings and close the room. The web client calls
this when the last person hangs up (abrupt exits fall back to the room's
departure timeout). Auth: this call's LiveKit token.

get.description:
Validate a ``/show <url>`` chat link before it is sent: it must resolve
(redirects followed, public hosts only) and is classified so receivers can
present it full screen. ``422 media_unavailable`` carries a user-facing
reason. Auth: this call's LiveKit token.

post.description:
A full-resolution photo from a participant's (phone) camera, taken when
someone in the call asked for one. Raw image body (JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤25 MB);
stored beside the recordings and logged as a ``photo`` event.
Auth: this call's LiveKit token (the photo is attributed to its identity).

get.description:
Stable link to a call photo: redirects to a fresh signed URL. Auth: none,
like the recordings list (anyone with the call link).

post.description:
Interaction log from a participant's client (what *it* sent/did), stored
with server receive timestamps and exported beside the recordings.
Auth: this call's LiveKit token (identity/name come from the token).
Start recording every participant's tracks. Auth: this call's LiveKit token.
Stop all recordings in the call. Auth: this call's LiveKit token.

Nudge after publishing a track so it is recorded without waiting for the
background loop. No-op when recording is off.
Store a LiveKit token behind a short, human-shareable URL code.

Mint a support LiveKit token for the regression harness.

This bypasses Firebase auth and assigns a synthetic support identity. It is
meant for one test run per session.

get.description:
List recordings and transcript exports for the regression harness.

Mirrors ``GET /v1/sessions/{id}/recordings`` but uses the service key so the
harness does not need Firebase support auth.
Redirect a short join link to the web client with the token attached.

Web client entry point (e.g. https://host/livekit/). The query names
the kind of link: ``?call=<code>`` meetings, ``?session=<id>`` support
sessions; no parameter starts a new meeting.

Short support join link: redirects into the web client, which signs
the operator in with Google and joins via POST /v1/sessions/join.
